title: Fuse two encoded CRT payload sorts into one
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

One live encoded CRT root now routes all 16 marked records of the retained `two_short_first` right rectangle. Writing both destination fields before sorting gives the same forward frame as sorting after each axis. The fused route takes four literal radix passes and 492,724 radix instructions. The matched staged route takes eight passes and 985,448 radix instructions. Both forward arms execute the same numerical work, two ROM calls and 96 physical row queries. The fused inverse restores the original payload, source, physical backing and entry heads.

The independent CRT oracle checks the complete permutation from the fixed left state `(1,5)`, including padded coordinates, and source `(1,5,2,1)` → `(1,5,0,0)` → `(1,5,2,1)`. `RESULT.json` records the live headers, shared bank and separate execution counts. This is a finite matched comparison under the retained full-frame radix ABI. A complete multiplier, a common literal tariff and a numerical κ improvement remain open.

## Task and overlap

Refined `uniform-transfer-audit` scope (priority revision 8). #5519 at `53a034436f17ef5b8fdf7a02f5066528cdfe5446` supplies the retained fixture and shared-bank record-alignment invariant. #7352 at `8c0e55c9ba25ff2c8199b01539a4d56ae71a1473` supplies the live forward/inverse root, with #7351's shared writer. #7388 executes one right-axis fiber. This change uses its unchanged row traversal and literal mover for both axes of one root and adds the matched comparison. [Discussion #4709 claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4709#discussioncomment-19559193).

The branch starts from canonical `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` and carries the exact #7388 dependency commit `d6f4a69202ad0bba4a915f4d4f3eaba1fe431c86` plus its two unchanged #7257 onboarding prerequisites. Review the seven new package files in [the follow-up commit](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/commit/cf62e701f52adf2196923ab7356539e69713d55b).

## Validation

Run `python3.12 -I -B research/encoded-crt-two-target-payload/replay.py`. The registered replay and Python optimized replay passed in about 17 seconds each locally. The committed source history, bytes and modes passed preflight, and the checked Git-free export replay passed. Dropping the fast target moves tag `293` to slot 4 instead of 5. An unequal-width header-only case detects reusing the first offset on the second target. The noncommuting inverse-row and truncated-row controls also run.

## Credit

Commdata2338 (#5519), CubeJerry (#7351, #7352), Ali Romman (#5625) and JoyboyBrian (#5092, #5496, #5015). OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Pro materially assisted. Pro derived the slot map and checked the isolated radix component with supplied keys. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

The product-level gate needs one production-admitted catalogue, actual normalized transform returns and original-coordinate extraction through CRT and carry to the exact integer product. The fixed-left replay and its cost receipts isolate one payload seam of that larger task.
